$comment: Tested compatibility policy for DeepSeek Harness Desktop releases. Every formats[] row must be backed by evidence the verify:compatibility gate can machine-check: npm:<pkg>@<version>:<file-inside-package> must exist in the installed store, fixture:<repo-path> must hash to the pinned sha256, upstream:<commit> must equal the DSH baseline commit, repo:<repo-path> must exist in this repository. Unknown formats must never be added without that evidence.

formats.$notes: <home>/.credentials.yaml carries an upstream-defined `version: 1` header with a refs: map; the pre-release flat layout is refused by the provider itself.
<home>/settings.yaml (or .json) is a schemastery-validated document with NO upstream numeric schema version; the provider build itself is the format identity. No schema version is fabricated.

First line of session.jsonl / session.jsonl.zstd is a {type:'session',version:N} header; this baseline writes SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION=0 and refuses headers carrying retired policy fields. .zstd files are multi-frame.

Single-layout units are one document with a nested {unit:{name,version}} header; per-record units are directories of {version,record} documents (global.json carries the unit version stamp) plus the domain identity from the directory name. Per-domain versions are declared by the owning package and checked with version-mismatch refusal.
The session_projcache storage domain is declared at version 4 with the per-record layout in this baseline.

A profile directory is a package.json manifest (dsh.profile.bundles) plus cordis.patch.yml plus pnpm-workspace.yaml. The manifest template is app-owned (profile-manager) and pinned to this baseline; the patch layer is the user's.
